keyscreen-01 is available. State: profile default, wallpaper dark_ocean.png, miss_rate 0.01, lang ru.
Tools (call_device; argument names exactly as listed):
- list_wallpapers: List wallpapers stored on the keyboard and the active profile. No arguments.
- set_wallpaper: Set the wallpaper (and optional accent theme colour #rrggbb, key opacity 0-255) of a profile. Arguments: wallpaper: string, required; profile: string, optional; theme: string, optional; opacity: integer 0–255, optional.
- set_profile: Create or update a per-app profile: legends maps key label to shown text, modules lists bar items (clock, app, wpm). Arguments: app: string, required; legends: object, optional; modules: list of string, optional; activate: boolean, optional.
- set_language: Switch the keyboard language: en (English QWERTY), ru (Russian ЙЦУКЕН), fr (French AZERTY), de (German QWERTZ), or next to cycle. Key legends change on the board and the PC is switched to the matching layout. Arguments: lang: one of en|ru|fr|de|next, required.
- adjust_key: Nudge one key's touch area by dx/dy pixels (each clamped to ±40) to reduce misses. Arguments: key: string, required; dx: number -20–20, required; dy: number -20–20, required.
- get_touch_stats: Per-key touch statistics: count, miss_rate, average offset from key centre (dx, dy px) and press time. Arguments: since_minutes: number 0–…, optional.
- preview_layout: Describe the rendered keyboard (size, active profile, wallpaper) to preview a layout change. No arguments.
- pet_say: Make the Agnes desk pet on the keyboard's top half say a short line in a speech bubble. Arguments: text: string, required; seconds: number 1–60, optional.
- pet_act: Make the Agnes desk pet do an action: jump, run, wave, dance, sit, spin or cheer. Arguments: action: one of jump|run|wave|dance|sit|spin|cheer, required.
Data sources (read_device sources; watch_device {"source", "field"} for values and switch):
- touch: values (total, miss_rate, latency_ms ms), 1 Hz — typing statistics from the touch surface
